text:
7 hours ago 📅 Evening wagon ride at Natural Tunnel State Park
Take a relaxing evening wagon ride through the park and campground and enjoy the sights and sounds of summertime.
Date: Sept. 26, 2026 Time: 6:00 p.m. – 7:00 p.m. Program location: Picnic Area Park address: Natural Tunnel State Park, 1420 Natural Tunnel Pkwy., Duffield, VA 24244 Cost:
$5 per adult $3 per child under 12 No standard parking or admission fee applies. Pre-registration is required. To sign up or ask questions, call the park office at 276-940-2674 or email naturaltunnel@dcr.virginia.gov .
The park also offers EnChroma red/green colorblindness-correcting outdoor glasses (three protan and three deutan) for guests to use during programs.
